fixed.summary: A document's t() text, its i18n keys and its controls' item keys are pseudo-localised too (accented, 40 % longer, in brackets), not only og.i18n.t's: the pseudo cells run in og-i18n's pseudo-locale, which lengthens every translated text alike, instead of wrapping og.i18n.t in process. og.i18n.t under the pseudo-locale (`og run --locale pseudo`) is lengthened the same way.
